statement: The five layers cover all functions needed for booking, payment and settlement.
The booking state machine covers all realistic reservation outcomes.
The architecture can integrate with existing OTA and PMS systems.
Fiat and stablecoin payment routing is technically feasible.
The threat model covers the main risks of handling guest funds.
The implemented mitigations are adequate for a pilot.
The capacity margin is sufficient for Lagoi's demand.
The cost per booking is acceptable to hotel operators.
The revenue-sharing rule is acceptable to stakeholders.
The SDG community fund is meaningful for the destination.
The design respects Indonesian currency and crypto-asset rules.
